exposed_pad.note: Standard 5-lead TSOP-5 / TSOT-23-5 (CASE 483, SN suffix) package has no exposed thermal pad.

theta_ja_c_per_w.condition: TSOP-5 (CASE 483) junction-to-ambient thermal resistance (Maximum Ratings table, p.2)

tj_max_c.condition: Maximum operating junction temperature +125°C (internal thermal shutdown typically 160°C, Note 2, p.2)

pd_max_mw.condition: Maximum package power dissipation at TA = 25°C with TJ(max) = 125°C and RθJA = 250°C/W (p.13)

pinout.name: Vin
pinout.description: Positive power supply input voltage (up to 6.0 V max; 3.8 V to 6.0 V line-regulation test range for 3.3 V variant).

pinout.name: Enable
pinout.description: Active-high standby control (>= 0.9 V ON, <= 0.15 V OFF); can be driven by 1.0 V logic; connect to Vin if unused.

pinout.name: N/C
pinout.description: No internal connection (low-noise 50 uVRMS performance achieved without an external bypass capacitor).

pinout.name: Vout
pinout.description: Regulated 3.3 V output voltage (requires >= 1.0 uF ceramic or tantalum output capacitor).

vin_abs_max_v.condition: Maximum Ratings Input Voltage Vin = 0 to 6.0 V (p.2)

vin_min_v.condition: NCP500-3.3 line regulation minimum test input voltage (3.8 V to 6.0 V; series minimum starts at 1.8 V for lower-Vout options, p.1 & p.6)

vin_max_v.condition: NCP500-3.3 maximum operating input voltage (also 6.0 V Maximum Rating, p.2 & p.6)

vout_v.condition: Fixed 3.3 V output variant (NCP500SN33T1G, marking LCX, Active on p.16)

vout_tolerance_pct.condition: 3.218 V to 3.383 V (±2.5%) across TA = -40°C to +85°C and Iout = 1.0 mA to 150 mA (p.1 & p.6)

iout_max_ma.condition: Rated continuous output current (short-circuit current limit 200 mA min / 540 mA typ / 700 mA max, p.6)

iq_typ_ua.condition: NCP500-3.3 quiescent current at Enable = 0.9 V, Iout = 1.0 mA to 150 mA, TA = 25°C (300 uA max over TA = -40°C to +85°C, p.6)

ishdn_typ_ua.condition: Enable Input = 0 V, TA = 25°C (1.0 uA max over TA = -40°C to +85°C, p.6)

dropout_typ_mv.condition: NCP500-3.3 at Iout = 150 mA, measured at Vout - 2.0%, TA = 25°C (230 mV max over temp; 80 mV typ / 110 mV max at 75 mA, p.6)

psrr_db.condition: Ripple Rejection at f = 1.0 kHz, Vin = Vout(nom) + 1.0 V + 0.5 Vpp, Io = 60 mA, Cout = 1.0 uF (p.6)

min_cout_uf.condition: Minimum 1.0 uF ceramic or tantalum output capacitor; stability plot verified 1 uF to 10 uF (p.1, p.12, Fig. 29 p.14)

esr_min_ohm.condition: No minimum ESR required ('does not require a minimum Equivalent Series Resistance', p.12; Fig. 29 p.14 stable down to <= 0.01 ohm)

design_gotchas.title: Pin 4 is N/C (Not BYPASS) — Fast 20 us Turn-On Without External Bypass Cap
design_gotchas.detail: NCP500 achieves 50 uVRMS low noise internally with Pin 4 left N/C (p.1-2, p.12). Installing it onto a legacy SOT-23-5 footprint that has a 10 nF bypass cap on Pin 4 is electrically harmless (since Pin 4 is unconnected), but verify startup timing since NCP500 turns on in 20 us typ vs. milliseconds for bypass-cap LDOs.

design_gotchas.title: Zero Headroom Between Operating Max and Absolute Max VIN (Both 6.0 V)
design_gotchas.detail: Maximum Ratings (p.2) lists Input Voltage = 0 to 6.0 V—identical to the 6.0 V line-regulation operating upper limit (p.6). Supply transients exceeding 6.0 V on 5 V USB or wall-adapter rails risk device damage; add TVS clamping or choose a higher-VIN regulator if surges exceed 6.0 V.

design_gotchas.title: Enable Slew-Rate Requirement (> 10 mV/us) & High TSOP-5 RθJA (250°C/W)
design_gotchas.detail: Applications Information (p.12) specifies that Enable turn-on/turn-off transients should exceed 10 mV/us for reliable switching. Additionally, TSOP-5 RθJA = 250°C/W caps total dissipation at 400 mW at TA = 25°C (p.13), leaving limited thermal margin at 5.5 V->3.3 V, 150 mA (330 mW) above 40°C ambient.

design_gotchas.title: DFN6 & Non-Standard Voltages Discontinued in Rev. 23 — Only Select TSOP-5 OPNs Active
design_gotchas.detail: Per Ordering Information (p.16, Rev. 23 Feb 2026), NCP500SN33T1G (TSOP-5, marking LCX) and automotive NCV500SN33T1G remain Active, whereas all DFN6 (SQL) variants and several voltage options (e.g., 2.8 V, 5.0 V commercial) are Discontinued.

typical_use_cases: Low-noise RF stages, VCOs, and portable instrumentation needing 50 uVRMS noise without a bypass cap
Fast-waking duty-cycled sensor rails leveraging 20 us turn-on time and 10 nA typical shutdown current
1.0 V–1.8 V MCU GPIO-controlled power domains (EN logic-high threshold >= 0.9 V)
Candidate drop-in for standard 5-pin SOT-23/TSOT-23 LDO footprints with Pin 4 N/C or unused BYPASS
engineering_summary: The onsemi NCP500SN33T1G is an Active 150 mA low-noise CMOS LDO in TSOT-23-5 (CASE 483 / TSOP-5) featuring 150 mV typical dropout at 150 mA, 20 us fast enable turn-on, 50 uVRMS noise without an external bypass capacitor (Pin 4 = N/C), and 0.9 V-compatible enable logic. It is stable with 1.0 uF ceramic capacitors (0 to 1.0 ohm ESR) and serves as a candidate drop-in for Pin-4-NC SOT-23-5/TSOT-23-5 footprints; engineers must verify the strict 6.0 V abs-max VIN ceiling, 195 uA active IQ, and 250°C/W thermal budget before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.1-2 confirmed TSOP-5 (CASE 483) Top View pinout (1=Vin, 2=GND, 3=Enable, 4=N/C, 5=Vout), Vin abs max 6.0 V, RθJA=250°C/W, and TJ(max)=125°C.
300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.6 confirmed -3.3 V Electrical Characteristics (3.218-3.383 V, 150 mV typ / 230 mV max dropout @150 mA, 195 uA typ IQ, 0.01 uA typ shutdown, 62 dB RR).
300 DPI PNG Vision check on p.14 (Fig. 29) confirmed ceramic stability down to <=0.01 ohm up to ~1.0 ohm max ESR; p.16 confirmed NCP500SN33T1G Active (marking LCX) in Rev. 23 (Feb 2026).
